items.claim: Fluffy Hernandez will push a high pace against Rodriguez.
items.quote: Fluffy is just putting the pace on him.

items.claim: Rodriguez will become exhausted against the fence under Hernandez's pressure.
items.quote: Rodriguez exhausted up against the fence and Fluffy just hitting the pitterpatter

items.claim: Fluffy Hernandez's power does not typically result in clean one-punch knockouts, but rather accumulates damage over time.
items.quote: what we've seen from Fluffy with his power, it's not putting guys out. It's like that death by a thousand paper cuts
